title: Mixing: Oo You by Paul McCartney | 1970
content:
Studio One, Morgan Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Robin Black

Paul McCartney mixed one song for the McCartney album on 26 February 1970.

McCartney and engineer Robin Black worked on ‘Oo You’. Black added echo to McCartney’s guitar feedback, and panned the guitar across the stereo spectrum.

Page last updated: 10 November 2025
